cases.semantics: direct-child pseudo evaluation must preserve occurrence markers until selector-group union completes
workflow output must strip internal occurrence markers only after the final selector chain

representativeRules: body > table:nth-child(4) > tbody > tr > td > span > a

legadoSemantics.markerPolicy: internal source occurrence identity is an implementation detail; it must not appear in workflow output
legadoSemantics.selectorGroupPolicy: different matching Element instances remain distinct; the same Element matched by multiple groups is emitted once in document order
